summary: Agent repeatedly asked for more details without addressing clear questions about office hours, insurance, appointment availability, cancellations, weekends, telehealth, or new-patient instructions. No progress was made.

issues.description: The patient explicitly asked about hours, in-network status for BCBS PPO, earliest appointments, weekend/virtual options, cancellations, and new-patient guidance. The agent ignored these intents and looped with a generic prompt.
issues.recommendation: Implement intent recognition to extract and confirm goals (hours, insurance verification, scheduling). Use targeted follow-up questions and provide direct answers or escalate to staff when unable to fulfill.

issues.description: The agent repeated the exact phrase 'Can you provide more details?' throughout the call, creating an unproductive loop.
issues.recommendation: Add loop-detection, conversation state management, and varied, context-aware prompts. After two failed turns, summarize what was heard and escalate or offer alternatives.

issues.description: No acknowledgment, empathy, or summarization. The agent failed to answer any question, provide structure, or guide next steps.
issues.recommendation: Acknowledge requests, summarize, and proceed stepwise (e.g., 'Let’s start with hours, then insurance, then scheduling'). Provide clear answers and confirmations.

issues.description: No attempt to check availability or gather required details (patient name/DOB/contact, visit type, provider preference, time windows) despite multiple explicit scheduling requests.
issues.recommendation: Follow a scheduling workflow: collect demographics and visit type, check calendar, propose 2–3 time slots (including early/late options), offer waitlist for cancellations, and confirm telehealth availability.

issues.description: Failed to address whether Blue Cross Blue Shield PPO is in-network or explain verification steps.
issues.recommendation: Provide general in-network guidance, verify plan details when permitted, and instruct the patient to bring/upload insurance card and ID. Note that final eligibility is determined by the plan at time of service.

issues.description: Did not provide office hours, weekend availability, telehealth options, cancellation/waitlist process, or new-patient prep (arrive early, bring ID/insurance card, med list, prior records, copay info, portal signup).
issues.recommendation: Proactively answer common administrative questions and share first-visit checklist and portal enrollment instructions.

issues.description: No triage or guidance for urgent concerns or after-hours care, though the call was administrative.
issues.recommendation: Add safety language: if symptoms are urgent, call 911 or go to the ER; provide after-hours nurse line or on-call instructions when discussing scheduling constraints.
